description: Paper 3 Regime C – explicit RVE (G4MultiUnion), minimal feasible geometry. 250-nm RVE (N~45 spheres, r=25 nm) at phi=0.189 (63.72 wt% WO3, rho_eff=2.124 g/cm3). Keeps the same particle radius as regime B (r=25 nm) and the same volume fraction; box side reduced so that G4Voxelizer grid (2N)^3 = 90^3 = 729000 cells. L/r = 10 satisfies the minimum RVE criterion. Photon energy sweep 30-1332 keV, 10M histories/point. W K-edge at 69.525 keV resolved between 50 and 80 keV grid points.
